followup.action: If a setting passes all reconstruction criteria, review its diagnostics and runtime before fresh full-GAN paired fits of candidate vs hidden24 ordinary. All three stages use 5000 updates, seed2026, no context/order penalty; full-GAN reference remains authors objective. Never warm-start from these probes or change budgets to fit time.
followup.full_gate: At least 5pp invalidity improvement; spread KL, return KL and ACF error each no more than 5% worse; depth SSIM no more than 0.01 lower; fixed-anchor price and volume noise SD/real SD >=0.1 in all three predetermined cases. Check selected and fixed-final checkpoints, diversity and reconstruction. No quality claim from reconstruction alone.
followup.repeats: Paired independent seeds2027/2028 only if full-pilot screen passes and measured runtime plus margin fits before 09:30 Brisbane. Do not pool unmatched budgets or select a lucky seed.
followup.stop_rule: If none qualifies, preserve the negative evidence and report without launching a blind grid.
followup.runtime: Estimate each further fit from completed wall time and current stage throughput, include at least20% margin and data/evaluation overhead, preserve30min reporting. At most2 training jobs including any existing.

plan.publishing: Existing timegan_results.ipynb and reports/timegan only; preserve all historical results. Do not modify README prose, AI disclosure or user commitlog. No commits, pushes or PRs in this study.

conclusion: Reconstruction improvements did not produce a better simulator. The larger partially weighted model reduced selected return KL and ACF error, but worsened invalidity (85.96% versus76.39%), spread KL (0.124 versus0.071) and depth SSIM (0.106 versus0.124). Its final checkpoint had93.09% invalid snapshots. Noise variation survives; this is not the strong-penalty collapse. Both full-pilot screens fail, so no seed expansion was run.

full_audit.noise_scope: 128 sequences per seed, SD across noise at fixed update positions, divided by global real-validation feature SD; price/volume separately. These models receive no anchor input, so scaled-feature noise ratios are identical for all three fixed anchors. Decoded cases use each anchor; no structural repair.

interpretation: Selected candidate price/volume reconstruction MSE divided by validation variance is0.440/0.00654, versus1.039/0.232 for the control, yet reconstructed invalidity is80.68% versus74.85%. Low feature MSE is therefore insufficient to preserve the price ladder. Selected generated price noise SD is1.867 times the real-validation scale versus1.080 for control; excessive price variability and poorer cross-level dependence accompany lower marginal return KL. The post-hoc price-correlation diagnostic is descriptive, not a new selection gate.
next_step: Before further broad training, design a matched experiment that models the price ladder jointly while retaining price-log-return targets. Check that its reconstruction preserves ordering and that noise remains diverse, then compare all validation metrics and repeat paired training seeds only after a useful pilot. Keep final-test scoring deferred.
limitations: One independent training seed per neural mode; generation-seed SD is not retraining uncertainty.
The fresh control exactly reproduces the earlier seed2026 weights, so it does not add an independent seed to historical summaries.
All criteria and examples are validation based; no final test scoring.
The candidate changes width and reconstruction weighting together; the four E/R probes separate their reconstruction effects, not their full-GAN effects.
A lower ACF scalar error alone does not establish realistic temporal dependence; retain the earlier shuffled-return diagnostic.
Both selected and fixed-final checkpoints and all failed probe settings are retained.

depth_specification.images: Separate ask and bid images, each 10 levels x sequence_length updates; levels 1 through 10.
depth_specification.aggregation: Mean over valid 7x7 windows, then equal mean of sides, sequences and generation seeds.
depth_specification.clipping: none; negative or above-training-range depths stay in the score and validity checks
depth_specification.reference_range: Nominal training reference range [0, 1]; fixed even for held-out or generated extremes.
depth_specification.variant: Wang et al. SSIM equation; 7x7 uniform windows/sample covariance, not the paper's 11x11 Gaussian setting.
